description: Order-pricing helpers that copy with spreads throughout; applyCoupon spreads the order but then writes into next.totals, a nested object the shallow copy still shares with the caller's order, so the input is mutated

hard.note: The writes target a spread copy, which looks safe; only the nested totals object is shared, so the caller's order changes. Every other function copies correctly

_calibration.note: Window allows the two writes to be reported separately plus one incidental suggestion; parameter mutation is error per js-fp-review.md
